policy.purpose: Preserve useful historical reconstruction while preventing unvalidated reconstruction assumptions from being presented as authoritative empirical evidence.

parameter_families.source: Fallback used only when no prior player observation exists; positional historical baseline remains the primary evidence anchor.
parameter_families.validation: Replace with position/experience-conditioned estimate from prior completed FSFFL seasons when sample permits; temporal holdout required for promotion.

parameter_families.source: Dated external market values dominate when available; proxy is restricted to players absent from the dated source.
parameter_families.validation: Fit only from dated historical market snapshots paired with prior-information player features; require time-ordered holdout improvement over positional-rank baseline.

parameter_families.source: Player realized weekly SD and position CV are estimated from the prior completed FSFFL season when available. Fixed CVs are fallback only; quartile transform approximates a Normal distribution.
parameter_families.validation: Archived forecast residual coverage by position/horizon is required before authoritative uncertainty claims.

parameter_families.source: Pre-trade ACL recovery status is knowable, but a calibrated point-in-time return distribution is not archived for this case.
parameter_families.validation: Replace with dated injury-status/prognosis evidence or historically estimated return-to-play distribution conditioned on injury and time since injury.

parameter_families.source: 2024 future-pick values use a dated FantasyPros anchor; later years are extrapolated rather than learned from a frozen term structure.
parameter_families.validation: Estimate annual term structure from dated dynasty-market snapshots across future horizons; promote only with temporal holdout improvement.

parameter_families.source: Scenario prior maps reconstructed competitive state to early/mid/late pick uncertainty; no claim of calibrated probability.
parameter_families.validation: Estimate from historical original-owner preseason state versus realized rookie-draft slot using only information available at each prediction date.

parameter_families.source: Birth date is time-invariant and safe. Present-day age/years_exp reverse arithmetic is a fallback and is not sufficient for authoritative historical calibration.
parameter_families.validation: Prefer immutable birth date, draft year and dated roster metadata; flag any reconstructed case that depends materially on present metadata.
